Position: Humans are Missing from AI Coding Agent Research

The Problem

AI agents evaluated in isolation

  • Benchmarks measure autonomy
  • SWE-bench, HumanEval
  • No human collaboration
  • Static expert assumption
  • Missing adaptation measures

What's Missing

Human-agent interaction

  • Developer-specific preferences
  • Continuous learning loops
  • Evolving expertise modeling
  • Feedback responsiveness
  • Collaboration quality metrics

Our Argument

Paradigm shift needed

  • Expertise is dynamic
  • Adaptation requires HITL
  • Success = partnership quality
  • Bidirectional knowledge flow
  • Dual-layer adaptation design

Call to Action

Research priorities

  • Adaptation-over-time benchmarks
  • Parameter-free + parameter-based
  • Human workflow evolution studies
  • Collaboration quality frameworks
  • Human-centered AI systems
From autonomous agents → collaborative partners in human-agent systems
